103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

3922-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-progress.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, $N?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
3922-progress.title: Nugget Slugs

6543-progress.name: Kadrak
6543-progress.text: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
6543-progress.title: The Warsong Reports

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

92745-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
92745-complete.title: The State of the Mines

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92749-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-accept.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749-accept.title: A Dynamite Plan

92749-complete.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-complete.text: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...
92749-complete.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92750-accept.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92750-complete.name: Jasper Fel
92750-complete.text: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
92750-complete.title: Detonation at a Distance

92751-accept.name: Jasper Fel
92751-accept.text:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
92751-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92752-accept.text: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92753-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92753-accept.text:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753-accept.title: Destruction in Deadmines

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
